'''Piddock''' was the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|duke]] of [[Gogum Hive]]. He traded with the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vrixx'tt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TLA" />
